root_actions.invoked_by: demo-real-agent/deploy.sh at d9, through the existing sudoers rule
root_actions.note: The gate adds no sudo entry point. The single existing root action is enhanced in place to consume the one-shot authorization.

procedure.ruling: BEAAA-23726 CTO ruling of 2026-08-16: no repository-provided installer is authorized to execute as root, so this candidate ships none. The host owner performs only fixed administrative operations on named paths.
procedure.order: removals before replacements, so any abort leaves a strictly narrower host

backup.note: mkdir without -p is the fail-if-exists operation. Every attempt creates a fresh, previously absent directory; a second attempt that reaches an existing directory stops instead of overwriting a rollback set. Files are stored under their full target path inside the directory, never by basename, so no copy can collide with another.

install.reason: the single root action, enhanced in place: unchanged names-only preflight, then atomic consumption of the one-shot exact-d9 authorization
stale forced-command gate pinned to a68e7e09; replaced by the exact-d9 gate

validation.rejected: /usr/bin/python3 -m py_compile, which writes a __pycache__ directory beside the staged file inside /usr/local/sbin
validation.expect: no output, checked after each replacement and again at the end of installation

remove.reason: stale sudo authority for a68e7e0969b45e7eb8add18ff2007a305a0156aa preflight and deploy
root deploy wrapper pinned to a68e7e09; deploy.sh now runs unprivileged, so no root release runner remains

must_not_change.note: the one and only sudoers rule, unchanged by this candidate: uid 1002 may run the fixed helper with an empty argument list

preconditions.check: the forced command in the deployment account's authorized_keys is exactly /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-ssh-gate
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop; this candidate does not authorize an authorized_keys edit

preconditions.check: sshd's sftp subsystem is one of the shapes the gate accepts
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop and report the exact configured value; the upload leg would fail closed

preconditions.check: /etc/backbond is root-owned and not group or world writable
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop; the helper refuses to consume a grant from a writable directory

preconditions.check: the protected env file is unchanged at uid/gid 10001:10001 mode 0600
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop and report to BEAAA-23702; do not print any value from this file

preconditions.check: the deployment account reaches docker without sudo, as deploy.sh at d9 requires
preconditions.on_mismatch: stop and report; this candidate does not broaden docker access

preconditions.check: no arm file and no d9 release directory exist before installation

failed_install.rule: stop at the first non-zero exit
steps: STOP. Do not continue, do not retry the remaining steps, do not arm, do not deploy.
run the rollback procedure in INSTALL.md with BK set to the backup directory printed in step 1
attest the final state on BEAAA-23705 and report the failing step to BEAAA-23702
failed_install.why_this_is_coherent: the removals precede the replacements, so an abort part-way through leaves the host with strictly fewer privileges than it started with; the a68 sudo authority and root deploy wrapper are gone and the one-shot requirement is either in place or the canonical d9 preflight is

post_install_verification.check: the helper still reports the names-only secret preflight and then fails closed because nothing is armed
post_install_verification.expect: stdout 'secret_file: valid' plus '<NAME>: configured' lines, stderr 'deploy_authorization: absent', exit status 1
post_install_verification.note: exit 1 while unarmed is the correct fail-closed result, not an installation failure

post_install_verification.check: the deployment account holds exactly one sudo authority
post_install_verification.expect: only /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-secret-preflight with an empty argument list; no a68 deploy entry

post_install_verification.check: no bytecode cache was left beside either helper

arming.note: Installation MUST NOT create this file. The procedure in INSTALL.md never creates it and one of the preconditions stops if it already exists. Arming is a separate operator action taken only after BEAAA-23702 returns READY and the Founder decision stands.

restores: /usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-secret-preflight to the backed-up e1d50aec40829636e2ab68488c8887d1bd0e796c8aef9b62f2b66a07445f1542 bytes; this alone removes the one-shot behaviour and returns the host to canonical d9 preflight
/usr/local/sbin/backbond-real-agent-demo-ssh-gate to the backed-up 44ff5dfa0faac3174bc97b0546a51194a16ce2fac40ac15f9da984460d5d323f bytes, a forced command pinned to a68 that denies every d9 command
rollback.then: re-attest both restored files with sha256sum and stat, and remove /etc/backbond/real-agent-demo-deploy.allow if it exists
rollback.note: The rollback procedure contains no step that recreates the stale a68 sudo authority or the root deploy wrapper, and it stops if either is present. A return to the a68 posture would be a new privileged change and must go back through BEAAA-23702.
